review_notes.note: AA 0516B1 and BJ 0516A1 each print a second right-facing physical output at location row, visibly commoned with the mid output by an outside loop and printed diamond. The open K-like source symbol replaces the normal right border (AA80 andBJ126); D13/B12 begins immediately in the next cell81/127. Native seven-cell border calibration confirms all six location characters fit the interior; prior +1/wedge interpretation is superseded. LiteralK is retained, trianglefalse, with no gap added. AA D13 and BJ B12 retained separately as additional printed outputs.

Duplicate BIT labels traced independently in original-size rail strips. Bank 2 lower D04 takes +02 LS811FB4 row49, bank4 also FB4 row49, bank6 takes LS811FD4 row45. Banks2/4 upper B13 share LS811GC4 row5; bank6 upper B13 is LS811GB4 row4. Banks2/4 D05 qualifiers use LS811FH4 row48 while bank6 uses LS811FF4 row44. Banks2/4 B12 qualifiers use LS812FC4 row46 while bank6 uses LS812FE4 row50. BD physical bottom pins B12 then D05; CD separately prints D05 then B12, with row4 connected to +03 FF and row5 to +04 FE. Native31 confirms the CD exception.

Washed and subcell interruptions remain normalized only where the printed wire or lettering can still be identified. Source electrical continuity is not certified by glyph continuity.
